newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar cuts Dec Qatar Marine, Land formula by 1 ct.
newsitem.headline: Qatar cuts Dec Qatar Marine, Land formula by 1 ct.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has lowered its price formula for December-lifting Qatar Land and Marine crude oil by one cent per barrel, traders in Tokyo said on Tuesday.

According to the QGPC formula, December Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 68 cents per barrel, which translated into $23.50 per barrel, and December Qatar Marine at Oman plus 61 cents per barrel, or $23.43 per barrel.
November Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 69 cents per barrel, and November Qatar Marine at Oman plus 62 cents per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Mines.
